title: Tropicaliente returns in September on the Globoplay Novelas channel
seoTitle: Tropicaliente airs in September on Globoplay Novelas
subtitle: Walther Negrão's soap opera replaces Anjo Mau and will also be available in full on streaming
excerpt: The soap opera Tropicaliente will be re-aired starting in September on the Globoplay Novelas channel, bringing back Letícia and Ramiro's romance.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The pay-TV rerun channel Globoplay Novelas has scheduled the premiere of the soap opera Tropicaliente for September 7th, replacing Anjo Mau in the lineup. In addition to the linear broadcast on the channel, Walther Negrão's work will be fully available on the Globoplay streaming service for anyone wanting to binge-watch it. The production, originally broadcast in 1994, features a love story set on the coast of Ceará.

The main plot and conflicts of love

The central plot revolves around the forbidden romance between Letícia, played by Silvia Pfeifer, and the fisherman Ramiro, a role played by Herson Capri. In her youth, Letícia decides to leave the comfort of her family and industrialist father, Gaspar (Francisco Cuoco), to live with Ramiro in a beach hut. However, after Ramiro spends three months at high sea, she believes she has been abandoned and travels to study outside of Brazil. Years later, a widow and mother of Vitor (Selton Mello) and Amanda (Paloma Duarte), Letícia returns to Ceará to take over the family's fishing business and reunites with Ramiro, who is now married to Serena (Regina Dourado) and has two children, Açucena (Carolina Dieckmann) and Cassiano (Márcio Garcia).

Supporting characters and notable debuts

In addition to the main couple, the soap opera features other important storylines. The audience follows François' (Victor Fasano) schemes and the scams of the con artist Franchico (Cássio Gabus Mendes). There is also the romance between young Cassiano and Dalila (Carla Marins), daughter of the fisherman Samuel (Stênio Garcia). The work is remembered for marking the debut of Giovanna Antonelli and Daniela Escobar in the network's productions.

Trajectory and international repercussion of the work

Although it did not achieve a major audience phenomenon in Brazil during its original run, Tropicaliente won a loyal following over time, especially on streaming. Internationally, the production achieved unexpected success in Russia in 1996, even influencing debates during the country's electoral process at that time. Now, the pay-TV channel is using the soap opera to renew its programming grid, which functions as a rotating showcase of reruns for different generations.

Recaps of the first chapters in September

In the first chapters aired starting September 8, 2026, the conflicts begin to unfold on screen:

  • Tuesday (09/08/2026): Ramiro and Letícia reminisce about the past, while Serena suspects her husband and finds the hut with the initials 'R' and 'L', deciding to set fire to the place. Gaspar appoints Bonfim (Edney Giovenazzi) to assist Letícia in the company.
  • Wednesday (09/09/2026): Açucena and Dalila go to the river, where Vítor appears, but is driven away by Cassiano. Davi (Delano Avelar) reunites with his parents, Samuel and Ester (Ana Rosa), after 15 years.
  • Thursday (09/10/2026): Adrenalina (Natália Lage) arrives in Fortaleza and gets into a disagreement with Pessoa (Guga Coelho), who takes her to dinner at Isabel's (Lucia Alves) house. Letícia cries upon seeing the destroyed hut and enters the river fully clothed, scaring Açucena.
  • Friday (09/11/2026): Serena suspects that the woman in the river is Letícia. Meanwhile, Samuel reunites with Manoela (Cinira Camargo) and Pitanga (Gabriela Alves).
  • Saturday (09/12/2026): François shares a room with Franchico in Fortaleza and later meets Letícia. Serena sees Letícia at a shopping mall and is stunned.

With information from RD1, Noticiasdetv.com.
